annotations.title: Which JLPT level do I need in Japan? Visa / status Japanese rules a level meets

description: Compares a JLPT level (N1–N5, optional total score 0–180) plus optional BJT score and Japanese schooling with Japan's published Japanese-language rules as of 2026-11-09 (JLPT Advantages page + official CEFR reference, ISA HSP points table, 特定活動46号, 経営・管理 2025-10-16 revision, 特定技能 field pages, 育成就労 Japanese page, 永住許可ガイドライン 2026-10-01). level: n1 | n2 | n3 | n4 | n5 | none. Optional: score, bjtScore, japaneseDegree, japaneseHigherEd (専門学校 etc.), japaneseMajorAbroad, japaneseHighSchool, japaneseSchooling6y, yearsInJapan, jftBasic, titp2, titp2Care, careJapaneseTest, hsp, applyDate (rules starting 2027-04-01), today. Returns verdict (b2_plus | b1 | a2 | a1 | none), summary, cefr {level, atLeast, note}, hspPoints, metCount, items[] {id, name, nameJa, kind, status (met | not_met | exempt | points | no_points | considered_met | considered_unclear | considered_not_met | not_considered | not_in_force_yet | not_required | check_rules), rule, you, source}, nextLevelUnlocks, warnings, sources, disclaimer. Use for 'which JLPT level do I need for a Japan visa', 'does Business Manager need N2', 'JLPT N3 permanent residence 2027', 'JLPT CEFR level', 'HSP points JLPT', '日本語能力試験 何級 在留資格', '特定技能 N4'. Educational, not immigration advice; not affiliated with ISA or the JLPT organisers.

careJapaneseTest.description: Passed the Care Japanese Language Evaluation Test.

hsp.description: HSP holder or HSP family member.

japaneseDegree.description: Degree from a Japanese university / graduate school.

japaneseHighSchool.description: Japanese compulsory education + Japanese high school.

japaneseHigherEd.description: Graduated from a Japanese 専門学校, 高専 or junior college.

japaneseMajorAbroad.description: Majored in Japanese at a foreign university.

japaneseSchooling6y.description: 6+ years of primary/secondary school in Japan.

score.description: JLPT total score (総合得点) on that level, for the CEFR reference.

titp2.description: Completed Technical Intern Training (ii) in good standing.

titp2Care.description: That TITP (ii) was in nursing care.

yearsInJapan.description: Years living in Japan as a mid/long-term resident.
